tEn: Seedance 2.0: Advancing Video Generation for World Complexity
tZh: Seedance 2.0：面向世界复杂性的视频生成新进展
sEn: Seedance 2.0 is a native multimodal audio-video generation model that jointly handles text, image, audio, and video inputs, achieving industry-leading performance across key generation dimensions and supporting direct 4–15 second 480p/720p output.
sZh: Seedance 2.0 是一个原生多模态音视频生成模型，统一支持文本、图像、音频和视频输入，在视频与音频生成的关键维度上达到业界领先水平，并支持直接生成 4–15 秒、480p/720p 的音视频内容。
absEn: Seedance 2.0 is a new native multi-modal audio-video generation model, officially released in China in early February 2026. Compared with its predecessors, Seedance 1.0 and 1.5 Pro, Seedance 2.0 adopts a unified, highly efficient, and large-scale architecture for multi-modal audio-video joint generation. This allows it to support four input modalities: text, image, audio, and video, by integrating one of the most comprehensive suites of multi-modal content reference and editing capabilities available in the industry to date. It delivers substantial, well-rounded improvements across all key sub-dimensions of video and audio generation. In both expert evaluations and public user tests, the model has demonstrated performance on par with the leading levels in the field. Seedance 2.0 supports direct generation of audio-video content with durations ranging from 4 to 15 seconds, with native output resolutions of 480p and 720p. For multi-modal inputs as reference, its current open platform supports up to 3 video clips, 9 images, and 3 audio clips. In addition, we provide Seedance 2.0 Fast version, an accelerated variant of Seedance 2.0 designed to boost generation speed for low-latency scenarios. Seedance 2.0 has delivered significant improvements to its foundational generation capabilities and multi-modal generation performance, bringing an enhanced creative experience for end users.
absZh: Seedance 2.0 是一款新的原生多模态音视频生成模型，于 2026 年 2 月初在中国正式发布。与之前的 Seedance 1.0 和 1.5 Pro 相比，Seedance 2.0 采用了统一、高效且大规模的多模态音视频联合生成架构。这使得它能够支持文本、图像、音频和视频四种输入模态，并集成了迄今为止业界最全面的多模态内容参考与编辑能力之一。它在视频和音频生成的各个关键子维度上都带来了全面而显著的提升。在专家评测和公开用户测试中，该模型均表现出与该领域领先水平相当的性能。Seedance 2.0 支持直接生成时长 4 至 15 秒的音视频内容，原生输出分辨率包括 480p 和 720p。对于作为参考的多模态输入，其当前开放平台最多支持 3 个视频片段、9 张图像和 3 个音频片段。此外，我们还提供了 Seedance 2.0 Fast 版本，这是 Seedance 2.0 的加速变体，旨在提升低延迟场景下的生成速度。Seedance 2.0 在其基础生成能力和多模态生成性能方面均实现了显著改进，为最终用户带来了更出色的创作体验。

Video generation models have become a core technology for modern digital content infrastructure and generative AI ecosystems, with rapid, widespread adoption across professional content production and consumer-facing creative scenarios. Through years of iterative research and engineering optimization, the ByteDance Seed team has built full-stack generative media technologies — including previous Seedance video generation series [6, 15, 16, 23], Seedream image generation and editing series [5, 7, 13, 17, 19, 20], Seed-VL multimodal vision-language models [3, 4, 9] for cross-modal semantic understanding, and other key components [21, 22], which are now widely integrated into our large-scale product ecosystem, supporting video generation services for billion-level daily active users. In this work, we push the frontier of video generation technologies with a notable paradigm shift: from generating short video clips with limited controllability to robust, highly controllable video synthesis natively supporting diverse control signals. This industry-wide trend has driven the development of Seedance 2.0, our new model designed specifically to deliver enhanced generation quality with rich multi-modal controllability for large-scale creative engine platforms. Seedance 2.0 is a new native multi-modal audio-video generation model, officially released in China in early February 2026. Compared with its predecessors, Seedance 1.0 and 1.5 Pro [6, 16], Seedance 2.0 adopts a unified, highly efficient, and large-scale architecture for multi-modal audio-video joint generation. This allows it to support four input modalities: text, image, audio, and video, by integrating one of the most comprehensive suites of multi-modal content reference and editing capabilities available in the industry to date. It delivers substantial, well-rounded improvements across all key sub-dimensions of video and audio generation. In both expert evaluations and public user tests, the model has demonstrated performance on par with the leading levels in the field. Within its multi-modal framework, Seedance 2.0 is equipped with a full set of multi-modal reference and editing capabilities, supporting both standalone and combinatorial tasks, including subject control, motion manipulation, style transfer, special effects design and creative content generation, as well as video extension. This suite of capabilities renders the model applicable to a diverse array of creative production scenarios. The model achieves more accurate compliance with complex instructions and more stable motion performance, enabling it to accommodate more sophisticated production workflows. Coupled with its native, professional multi-shot narrative capability, vivid details of motion and facial expressions, and improved cross-frame consistency, the model reaches a competitive usability rate in real-world production settings. Seedance 2.0 supports direct generation of audio-video content with durations ranging from 4 to 15 seconds, with native output resolutions of 480p and 720p. For multi-modal inputs as reference, its current open platform supports up to 3 video clips, 9 images, and 3 audio clips. 视频生成模型已成为现代数字内容基础设施和生成式 AI 生态系统的核心技术，在专业内容生产和面向消费者的创意场景中得到快速而广泛的应用。经过多年的迭代研究与工程优化，字节跳动 Seed 团队构建了全栈生成式媒体技术——包括此前的 Seedance 视频生成系列 [6, 15, 16, 23]、Seedream 图像生成与编辑系列 [5, 7, 13, 17, 19, 20]、用于跨模态语义理解的 Seed-VL 多模态视觉语言模型 [3, 4, 9]，以及其他关键组件 [21, 22]。这些技术现已广泛集成到我们的大规模产品生态中，为十亿级日活跃用户提供视频生成服务。在本工作中，我们以一项显著的范式转变推动视频生成技术的前沿：从生成可控性有限的短视频片段，发展到原生支持多种控制信号、鲁棒且高度可控的视频合成。这一行业趋势推动了 Seedance 2.0 的开发，它是一款专为大规模创意引擎平台提供更强生成质量和丰富多模态可控性的新模型。Seedance 2.0 是一款全新的原生多模态音视频生成模型，于 2026 年 2 月上旬在中国正式发布。与上一代 Seedance 1.0 和 1.5 Pro [6, 16] 相比，Seedance 2.0 采用了统一、高效且大规模的多模态音视频联合生成架构。这使其能够支持文本、图像、音频和视频四种输入模态，并集成了迄今业界最全面的多模态内容参考与编辑能力之一。它在视频和音频生成的所有关键子维度上都带来了实质性、全方位的提升。在专家评估和公开用户测试中，该模型都展现出了与领域领先水平相当的性能。在其多模态框架内，Seedance 2.0 配备了全套多模态参考与编辑能力，支持独立及组合任务，包括主体控制、运动操控、风格迁移、特效设计与创意内容生成，以及视频扩展。这套能力使该模型适用于多种创意生产场景。模型能够更准确地遵循复杂指令，并具有更稳定的运动表现，从而适应更复杂的生产工作流。结合其原生的专业多镜头叙事能力、生动的运动与面部表情细节，以及改进的跨帧一致性，模型在真实生产环境中达到了有竞争力的可用率。Seedance 2.0 支持直接生成时长 4 至 15 秒的音视频内容，原生输出分辨率为 480p 和 720p。对于多模态输入参考，其当前开放平台最多支持 3 段视频、9 张图像和 3 段音频。此外，我们还提供 Seedance 2.0 Fast 版本，这是 Seedance 2.0 的加速变体，旨在提升低延迟场景下的生成速度。Seedance 2.0 在基础生成能力和多模态生成性能上均取得了显著进步，为终端用户带来了增强的创意体验。其关键模型能力如下：

• 真实世界复杂度生成。Seedance 2.0 在生成质量上实现了显著提升，尤其是在人体运动建模方面，与之前版本相比，自然度、时间一致性和物理合理性都大幅增强。它可以合成时间上精准、

complex interaction scenes with high fidelity, while adhering to real-world motion laws throughout the generation process, thereby mitigating the artifacts common in recent video generation models. For detailed close-up shots, the generated frames exhibit highly realistic details and rigorous consistency—whether for subtle changes in light refraction or natural, fluid interactions between characters and the environment—closely matching the visual fidelity of real-world live-action footage. With robust motion stability and physics compliance, the model delivers favorable performance in multi-subject interaction and complex motion scenarios, achieving a usability rate that is clearly higher than recent commercial models.

• Strong multimodal capability. First, Seedance 2.0 accepts a comprehensive multimodal reference input, allowing you to combine text, image, video, and audio sources. The model can accurately interpret multimodal input content and generate output referencing user-specified elements that include frame composition, cinematographic design, motion rhythm, and acoustic characteristics in accordance with user instructions. It can also directly reference text-based storyboards, enhancing the flexibility of conventional video generation workflows and expanding the creative freedom. Second, Seedance 2.0 features substantially improved controllability in video generation. It delivers strong instruction-following performance, accurately generating specified content, and maintaining consistent subject identity preservation even when processing complex scripts with extensive character interactions and fine-grained action descriptions. Meanwhile, the model exhibits fundamental directorial and cinematographic reasoning capabilities, enabling it to autonomously plan shot sequencing and design visual presentation templates. In addition, Seedance 2.0 introduces new video editing capabilities, which enable targeted modifications to specified clips, characters, actions, or plot elements. It also provides video continuation functionality, which generates consecutive shots aligned with user prompts, supporting both de novo video generation and seamless extension of existing footage.

• High-Fidelity Audio-Video Generation. Seedance 2.0 has binaural audio capability with synchronized high-fidelity immersive sound generation. It is equipped with an upgraded audio generation module integrated with binaural audio technology, which enables high-fidelity, immersive sound generation. The model supports simultaneous multi-track output of audio content including background audio, ambient sound effects, and character narration, with precise temporal alignment to the visual rhythm of generated footage. The audio content generated by the model features highly natural sound design, faithfully reproducing subtle natural ambient sounds to enhance scene immersion. Coupled with strict audio-visual temporal control, the model ensures tight synchronization between audio tracks and visual actions, providing robust support for professional-grade audio-visual content creation.

• Applications in Productivity Scenarios. It exhibits strong cross-scene adaptability, which reduces the barriers to professional content production. In response to the diverse demands of video content production, Seedance 2.0 demonstrates high cross-scene adaptability. It delivers high-quality generation results across a wide range of use cases, including commercial advertising, cinematic and television visual effects, game animation, and commentary videos. By replacing complex visual effects production and live-action shooting workflows with AI generation, Seedance 2.0 can significantly reduce production costs and shorten the production cycle of professional audio-video content, helping creators and enterprises realize their creative concepts. From the audio-video synchronous generation achieved by Seedance 1.5 [16] to the unified multimodal audio-video joint generation framework established by Seedance 2.0, the Seedance series has consistently been built around a unified architecture, with a core commitment to high-fidelity reconstruction of real-world complexity. We acknowledge that Seedance 2.0 remains imperfect, with room for improvement in its generation outputs. Moving forward, we will continue to explore deep alignment between generative models and the physical world, advance accurate modeling of real-world dynamics, deepen our understanding of physical and semantic rules, and enable the technology to better serve every creator. Safety is a core consideration in our work. Throughout the model iteration lifecycle, we have implemented a structured safety assessment framework and made continuous efforts to evaluate and mitigate potential risks, with the aim of supporting responsible, compliant, and ethically aligned development.

高保真的复杂交互场景，并在整个生成过程中遵循真实世界的运动规律，从而减轻近期视频生成模型中常见的伪影。对于细致的特写镜头，生成的帧展现出高度逼真的细节和严谨的一致性——无论是光线折射的微妙变化，还是角色与环境之间自然流畅的互动——与真实实景拍摄的视觉保真度高度匹配。凭借稳健的运动稳定性和物理遵循能力，模型在多主体交互和复杂运动场景中表现良好，可用率明显高于近期的商业模型。

• 强大的多模态能力。首先，Seedance 2.0 支持全面的多模态参考输入，允许组合文本、图像、视频和音频来源。模型能够准确理解多模态输入内容，并根据用户指令生成引用用户指定元素（包括画面构图、电影摄影设计、运动节奏和声音特征）的输出。它还可以直接引用基于文本的故事板，增强传统视频生成工作流的灵活性，拓展创作自由度。其次，Seedance 2.0 在视频生成方面具有大幅提升的可控性。它具有强大的指令遵循能力，能够准确生成指定内容，即使在处理包含大量角色交互和细粒度动作描述的复杂脚本时，也能保持主体身份的一致性。同时，模型展现出基础的导演和电影摄影推理能力，能够自主规划镜头顺序并设计视觉呈现模板。此外，Seedance 2.0 还引入了新的视频编辑能力，可对指定片段、角色、动作或情节元素进行针对性修改。它还提供视频续写功能，可生成与用户提示一致的后续镜头，既支持从零开始生成视频，也支持对现有素材进行无缝扩展。

• 高保真音视频生成。Seedance 2.0 具备双耳音频能力，可同步生成高保真沉浸式声音。它配备了集成双耳音频技术的升级音频生成模块，能够实现高保真、沉浸式的声音生成。模型支持同时输出多条音频轨道，包括背景音乐、环境音效和角色旁白，并与生成画面的视觉节奏精确对齐。模型生成的音频内容具有高度自然的声音设计，能够忠实再现细微的自然环境声，增强场景沉浸感。结合严格的视听时间控制，模型可确保音频轨道与视觉动作的紧密同步，为专业级音视频内容创作提供有力支持。

• 生产力场景应用。Seedance 2.0 展现出强大的跨场景适应能力，降低了专业内容生产的门槛。针对视频内容生产的多样化需求，Seedance 2.0 展示了高度的跨场景适应性。它能在商业广告、影视特效、游戏动画和讲解视频等广泛用例中提供高质量生成结果。通过用 AI 生成替代复杂的视觉特效制作和实景拍摄工作流，Seedance 2.0 能够显著降低专业音视频内容的制作成本并缩短制作周期，帮助创作者和企业实现其创意构想。从 Seedance 1.5 [16] 实现的音视频同步生成，到 Seedance 2.0 建立的统一多模态音视频联合生成框架，Seedance 系列始终围绕统一架构构建，核心承诺是对真实世界复杂度的高保真重建。我们承认 Seedance 2.0 仍不完美，在生成输出方面还有改进空间。展望未来，我们将继续探索生成模型与物理世界的深度对齐，推进对真实世界动态的精确建模，深化对物理和语义规则的理解，并让技术更好地服务每一位创作者。安全是我们工作的核心考量。在整个模型迭代生命周期中，我们实施了结构化的安全评估框架，并持续努力评估和缓解潜在风险，以支持负责任、合规且符合伦理的发展。

paras.en: Text-to-Video and Image-to-Video Evaluation. In video generation tasks, Seedance 2.0 delivers competitive leading performance in the industry. Marked improvements have been achieved in motion stability, instruction following capability, and visual aesthetics. The model effectively mitigates common structural inaccuracies and visual artifacts, generating smooth and nuanced complex motions. It can accurately render high-tension large-scale movements and subtle micro-expressions, while supporting professional-level combined camera movements and narrative rhythm control. For long scripts and open-ended instructions, the model can respond appropriately and deliver reasonable generation outputs. Meanwhile, the generated videos exhibit notable cinematic aesthetics, with well-rendered object textures, lighting and composition, as well as costume, makeup and prop design. In the audio domain, Seedance 2.0 maintains strong performance with substantial improvements in audio expressiveness. Its dual-channel audio output presents rich and nuanced layers, and can generate sound effects or melodies that align well with the context described in the prompts. Compared with the previous version, the model delivers an enhanced audio-visual integrated experience, with tighter alignment between dialogue lines, sound effects, background audio, and visual content. Meanwhile, the instruction following accuracy for Chinese dialects, traditional opera, and singing scenarios is significantly improved. The product pages can be accessed at https://www.doubao.com/chat/create-video and https://jimeng.jianying.com/ai-tool/video/generate.
paras.zh: 文生视频与图生视频评测。在视频生成任务中，Seedance 2.0 展现出业界领先的竞争力。在运动稳定性、指令遵循能力和视觉美学方面均取得了显著进步。该模型有效缓解了常见的结构失真和视觉伪影，能够生成流畅且细致入微的复杂运动。它可以准确渲染高张力的大幅动作和微妙的微表情，同时支持专业级的组合运镜和叙事节奏控制。对于长脚本和开放式指令，模型能够给出恰当响应并产生合理的生成结果。同时，生成的视频呈现出显著的电影级美学，物体纹理、光影构图以及服装、化妆和道具设计都得到了良好表现。在音频领域，Seedance 2.0 保持强劲性能，音频表现力大幅提升。其双声道音频输出层次丰富、细节饱满，并能生成与提示词所描述情境高度契合的音效或旋律。与上一版本相比，该模型提供更强的音视频一体化体验，台词、音效、背景音频与视觉内容之间的对齐更加紧密。同时，中文方言、传统戏曲和演唱场景下的指令遵循准确率显著提升。产品页面见 https://www.doubao.com/chat/create-video 和 https://jimeng.jianying.com/ai-tool/video/generate。

paras.en: Multi-modal Reference-Based Generation Evaluation. Seedance 2.0 achieves competitive leading comprehensive performance in reference-based generation tasks. The model supports a more comprehensive range of reference-based tasks, covering multiple creative scenarios including multi-modal reference-based generation, video editing, and video continuation. Meanwhile, it demonstrates advantages in the depth of understanding and response accuracy for reference content. Specifically, in video editing tasks, Seedance 2.0 delivers more complete instruction following and more photorealistic visual outputs compared with peer models. In terms of generation consistency, the model achieves favorable performance in subject appearance and voice restoration, with particularly notable advantages in maintaining reference consistency for action logic, special effect styles, and plot narrative. Despite these strengths, there is still room for optimization in multi-subject consistency, text restoration accuracy, and the performance of complex editing tasks. We evaluate Seedance 2.0 on three generation tasks—T2V (Text-to-Video), I2V (Image-to-Video), and R2V (Reference-to-Video)—against current commercial video generation models. Seedance 2.0 ranks first across all video and audio dimensions on every task. On video, the main advances are: (1) Stability—fewer deformations and structural issues; complex actions are fluid; multilingual text generation and preservation are relatively strong. (2) Vividness—sports, combat, and other high-amplitude actions carry strong momentum; facial expressions and gaze are emotionally engaging; the model produces professional-level camera movements, dynamic editing, and narrative pacing. (3) Instruction following—long-script prompts are executed with reasonable precision, multi-shot and multi-angle instructions are followed accurately, and open-ended prompts receive appropriate creative interpretation; multiple art styles are supported; in I2V, special art styles from the reference image are preserved while adapting subject motion to match. (4) Visual realism—object materials look authentic, lighting, composition, and character texture improve notably, and costume and prop design is polished. On audio: (1) Expressiveness—audio is detailed and layered, with dual-channel support; melodies and tones match the prompt context, and the audio dimension adds to the emotional impact of the video. (2) Audio-visual sync—lip movements match the visual, dialogue, sound effects, and background audio align well, and beat-matching between audio and video is strong. (3) Audio instruction following—Chinese dialects (Sichuan, Northeastern, Cantonese), opera, and singing improve markedly over the previous version; singing, rap, and instrumental performance are consistent, with melodies adapted to the prompt context. Areas for improvement remain: minor deformation artifacts, motion plausibility in edge cases, high-frequency visual noise, audio distortion and noise, and lip-sync errors in multi-speaker scenes. The following subsections present detailed results for each task.
paras.zh: 多模态参考生成评测。Seedance 2.0 在基于参考的生成任务中取得了具有竞争力的领先综合表现。该模型支持更全面的参考生成任务类型，覆盖多种创意场景，包括多模态参考生成、视频编辑和视频续写。同时，它在参考内容的理解深度和响应准确度方面展现出优势。具体而言，在视频编辑任务中，Seedance 2.0 相比同类模型实现了更完整的指令遵循和更逼真的视觉输出。在生成一致性方面，该模型在主体外观和声音还原上表现良好，尤其在保持动作逻辑、特效风格和剧情叙述的参考一致性方面具有突出优势。尽管有这些优点，但在多主体一致性、文字还原准确度以及复杂编辑任务的表现上仍有优化空间。我们以 T2V（文本到视频）、I2V（图像到视频）和 R2V（参考到视频）三项生成任务评估 Seedance 2.0，并与当前商业视频生成模型进行对比。Seedance 2.0 在每项任务的所有视频和音频维度上均排名第一。在视频方面，主要进展包括：(1) 稳定性——更少的形变和结构问题；复杂动作流畅；多语言文字生成与保持相对较强。(2) 生动性——运动、格斗等高幅度动作富有冲击力；面部表情和眼神具有情感感染力；模型能生成专业级运镜、动态剪辑和叙事节奏。(3) 指令遵循——长脚本提示词能以合理的精度执行，多镜头和多角度指令得到准确遵循，开放式提示词能获得恰当的创意诠释；支持多种艺术风格；在 I2V 中，保留参考图像的特殊艺术风格，同时让主体动作与之匹配。(4) 视觉真实感——物体材质看起来真实，光影、构图和角色纹理显著提升，服装和道具设计精细。在音频方面：(1) 表现力——音频细节丰富、层次清晰，支持双声道；旋律和音色与提示词情境匹配，音频维度增强了视频的情感冲击。(2) 音画同步——口型动作与画面匹配，对白、音效和背景音频对齐良好，音画同步节拍匹配强。(3) 音频指令遵循——中文方言（四川话、东北话、粤语）、戏曲和演唱相较上一版本显著提升；演唱、说唱和器乐演奏保持一致，旋律根据提示词情境调整。仍存在需要改进的地方：轻微的形变伪影、边缘情形下的运动合理性、高频视觉噪声、音频失真和噪声，以及多说话人场景下的口型错误。以下各小节将展示每项任务的详细结果。

paras.en: To prepare the model for production deployment, we upgraded our evaluation framework to SeedVideoBench 2.0. The new version adds multimodal generation, narrative quality, and multilingual coverage to the evaluation scope, and refines how audio expressiveness is assessed. We also brought in expert evaluators from advertising and game production to provide subjective ratings, with a focus on narrative and aesthetic quality.
paras.zh: 为了准备模型的生产部署，我们升级了评估框架至 SeedVideoBench 2.0。新版本在评估范围中增加了多模态生成、叙事质量和多语言覆盖，并改进了音频表现力的评估方式。我们还邀请了来自广告和游戏制作的专家评估员提供主观评分，重点关注叙事和美学质量。

paras.en: 2.2.1 SeedVideoBench 2.0 Two main changes define the new framework. First, a multimodal task evaluation system that formally defines multimodal task following and generation consistency, while also covering baseline generation quality (prompt following, motion quality) in multimodal settings. Second, we split evaluation into objective and subjective tracks. Objective metrics like motion stability—use automated pipelines. Subjective metrics like aesthetics—go through blind expert review. Separately, we ran a realism study: evaluators tried to tell Seedance 2.0 outputs apart from real video clips. The results fed back into our aesthetic tuning process. The multimodal task evaluation module and the narrative assessment module saw the largest changes from the previous version. paras.en: and extension scenarios, broken into dozens of fine-grained task types (subject identity, motion, style, etc.). Most models have limited multimodal coverage, which forces users to probe capability boundaries through trial and error; these metrics make the boundaries explicit. Specifically, the evaluation covers four task groups: • Reference tasks: subject, motion, visual-effects, and style reference generation. • Editing tasks: subject, style, scene, and audio content editing. • Extension tasks: plot continuation and seamless extension, both forward and backward on the timeline. • Combination tasks: paired evaluations that match real workflows—e.g., swapping a video subject with a reference image (reference + editing combined). Consistency captures how closely generated content matches the reference input (reference alignment) and how well non-edited regions survive during editing (editing consistency). We built specialized datasets covering subject, motion, scene, style, and audio, with sample distributions tuned to minimize variance at small evaluation budgets. On the video metrics side, SeedVideoBench 1.5 already tracked vividness; version 2.0 adds finer narrative quality metrics alongside the existing vividness and aesthetics dimensions. Unlike motion quality, which can be measured more objectively, narrative quality is inherently subjective—it asks whether the overall narrative reads as coherent, whether character performances and visual effects carry emotional weight, and whether the aesthetic choices fit the content. We evaluate it along three sub-dimensions: • Cinematographic language: does the camerawork support the story? We assess shot logic and expressiveness, looking for problems like redundant coverage, axis-crossing (180-degree rule violations), mismatched shot sizes, and uneven pacing. • Plot design: can the model take a vague or brief prompt and produce something both coherent and engaging? • Stylistic aesthetics: do the visuals have a considered look? This covers lighting, framing, composition, and color grading, plus whether characters, costumes, props, and sets hold together aesthetically. Unless otherwise noted, all evaluation results reported in the following sections are obtained using SeedVideoBench 2.0.
paras.zh: 和扩展场景的指令遵循准确度，细分为数十种细粒度任务类型（主体身份、运动、风格等）。大多数模型的多模态覆盖有限，这迫使用户通过试错来摸索能力边界；这些指标让边界变得明确。具体而言，评估涵盖四组任务：• 参考任务：主体、运动、视觉效果和风格参考生成。• 编辑任务：主体、风格、场景和音频内容编辑。• 扩展任务：情节延续和无缝扩展，包括时间线上的向前和向后扩展。• 组合任务：对应真实工作流的配对评估——例如，用参考图像替换视频主体（参考+编辑组合）。一致性捕捉生成内容与参考输入的匹配程度（参考对齐），以及编辑过程中非编辑区域的保留程度（编辑一致性）。我们构建了涵盖主体、运动、场景、风格和音频的专门数据集，样本分布经过调优，以在较小的评估预算下最小化方差。在视频指标方面，SeedVideoBench 1.5 已经跟踪生动性；2.0 版在现有生动性和美学维度基础上增加了更精细的叙事质量指标。与可以更客观测量的运动质量不同，叙事质量本质上是主观的——它询问整体叙事是否连贯，角色表演和视觉效果是否承载情感重量，以及美学选择是否契合内容。我们沿着三个子维度进行评估：• 电影语言：摄影是否支持故事？我们评估镜头逻辑和表现力，寻找诸如冗余覆盖、轴线交叉（违反180度原则）、镜头尺寸不匹配和节奏不均等问题。• 情节设计：模型能否根据模糊或简短的提示生成既连贯又引人入胜的内容？• 风格美学：视觉是否具有精心设计的外观？这涵盖灯光、取景、构图和调色，以及角色、服装、道具和布景在美学上是否协调。除非另有说明，以下部分报告的所有评估结果均使用 SeedVideoBench 2.0 获得。

paras.en: Arena (formerly LMArena) [2], created by researchers from UC Berkeley, is a community-powered platform that evaluates AI models through real-world user preferences. For video generation, users are presented with outputs from two anonymous models side-by-side and vote for the one they prefer, producing an Elo-style leaderboard that reflects genuine human judgment at scale. Unlike automated benchmarks that rely on metrics such as FVD or CLIPScore, Arena captures holistic human preferences encompassing visual quality, motion realism, temporal coherence, and prompt adherence in a single unified ranking. As shown in Figure 2, our Dreamina Seedance 2.0 720p ranks #1 on both the Text-to-Video and Image-to-Video leaderboards, with Elo scores of 1450 (±15) and 1449 (±11) respectively. On T2V (Figure 2a), it leads the second-place veo-3.1-audio-1080p by 79 points; on I2V (Figure 2b), it leads grok-imagine-video-720p by 29 points. Notably, the model achieves this at 720p resolution, outperforming competitors that operate at 1080p, which suggests that our improvements in motion dynamics and visual coherence are more perceptually significant than resolution alone. The Rank Spread of 1↔1 on both leaderboards indicates consistently top-ranked performance across evaluation dimensions. These results complement our SeedVideoBench 2.0 findings, demonstrating that the gains observed in objective metrics translate directly into stronger human preference.
paras.zh: Arena（原 LMArena）[2] 由加州大学伯克利分校的研究者创建，是一个通过真实用户偏好评估 AI 模型的社区驱动平台。对于视频生成，用户会并排看到两个匿名模型的输出，并投票选择他们更喜欢的那个，从而产生一个 Elo 风格的排行榜，反映大规模的真实人类判断。与依赖 FVD 或 CLIPScore 等指标的自动化基准不同，Arena 通过一个统一的排名捕捉整体的用户偏好，涵盖视觉质量、运动真实感、时间连贯性和提示遵循度。如图 2 所示，我们的 Dreamina Seedance 2.0 720p 在文生视频和图生视频排行榜上均排名第一，Elo 分数分别为 1450（±15）和 1449（±11）。在 T2V 上（图 2a），它领先第二名 veo-3.1-audio-1080p 79 分；在 I2V 上（图 2b），它领先 grok-imagine-video-720p 29 分。值得注意的是，该模型以 720p 分辨率实现了这一成绩，超越了以 1080p 运行的竞争对手，这表明我们在运动动态和视觉连贯性上的改进在感知上比单纯的分辨率更重要。两个排行榜上的 Rank Spread 1↔1 表明模型在评估维度上始终处于顶尖水平。这些结果补充了 SeedVideoBench 2.0 的发现，证明客观指标上观察到的提升直接转化为更强的人类偏好。

2.3.3 Video Prompt Following Compared to Seedance 1.5, version 2.0 improves on text rendering, physical phenomena, intent comprehension, and style following, with more precise action following and reasonable creative interpretation beyond the core instructions. paras.en: usability vs. Kling 3.0's 90.55%, though the satisfaction gap is wider (38.85% vs. 27.27%). The audio contrast is sharper. On audio quality, Seedance 2.0 reaches 97.42% usability and 57.08% satisfaction; Kling 2.6 and Wan 2.6 have usability below 28%, meaning most of their audio is rated unacceptable. On audio prompt following, Seedance 2.0's 63.52% satisfaction is 1.7× Seedance 1.5 Pro's 37.77% and over 10× Kling 2.6's 5.70%. Beyond the scores, human evaluation of generated videos surfaces additional patterns. Seedance 2.0 produces dynamic motion with a clear sense of momentum—combat and dance sequences mix slow-motion highlights with fast action in ways competitors do not, and facial expressions and gaze are more vivid than Seedance 1.5 Pro. Camera work tracks subject motion closely with varied angles and smooth push/pull transitions. First- and third-person game-following perspectives with handheld breathing effects are new to this version and add immersion. The model handles special art styles (felt, oil painting, Chinese gongbi) without breaking visual coherence, matching subject motion to the referenced style. Realistic and 3D visual effects render fluidly. On the audio side, dialogue voices carry emotional nuance in both Chinese and non-Chinese languages. Voice, sound effects, and audio are well-layered—outputs sound like composed audio rather than isolated tracks stacked together. Common Chinese dialects (Sichuan, Northeastern, Cantonese) come through accurately. Singing, rap, and instrumental audio across languages are strong, with melodies that fit the prompt context.
paras.zh: 可用率 vs. Kling 3.0 的 90.55%，但满意率差距更大（38.85% vs. 27.27%）。音频对比更加明显。在音频质量上，Seedance 2.0 达到 97.42% 的可用率和 57.08% 的满意率；Kling 2.6 和 Wan 2.6 的可用率低于 28%，意味着它们大部分音频被评为不可接受。在音频提示遵循上，Seedance 2.0 的 63.52% 满意率是 Seedance 1.5 Pro 的 37.77% 的 1.7 倍，是 Kling 2.6 的 5.70% 的 10 倍以上。除了分数之外，对生成视频的人工评估还揭示了其他模式。Seedance 2.0 生成具有清晰动感的动态运动——战斗和舞蹈序列将慢动作高光与快速动作混合在一起，这是竞争对手无法做到的，而且面部表情和目光比 Seedance 1.5 Pro 更加生动。镜头工作紧密跟踪主体运动，角度多变，推拉过渡平滑。第一人称和第三人称游戏跟随视角以及手持呼吸效果是此版本新增的，增加了沉浸感。该模型处理特殊艺术风格（毛毡、油画、中国工笔）时不会破坏视觉连贯性，并将主体运动与参考风格相匹配。写实和 3D 视觉效果渲染流畅。在音频方面，对话声音在中文和非中文语言中都带有情感细微差别。人声、音效和音频层次分明——输出听起来像是合成的音频，而不是互不相干的音轨叠加。常见的中国方言（四川、东北、广东）都能准确呈现。跨语言的歌唱、说唱和器乐音频都很出色，旋律贴合提示上下文。

paras.en: 14 Prompt Abstraction. This category tests UGC-style creative prompts and script-controlled generation. Seedance 2.0 leads on all three metrics for script-controlled (15s) generation and on MQ and IP for UGC creative/portrait (Table 11). The gap is largest on script-controlled (15s) generation: VPF 3.87 vs. Kling 3.0’s 3.00 and Wan 2.6’s 2.50. Veo 3.1 scores 3.87 on VPF for UGC creative/portrait—the best in that sub-category—but its MQ (2.53) and IP (2.87) are much lower. Kling 2.6 falls below 2.5 on MQ for both sub-categories, and Wan 2.6 drops to 2.14 on script-controlled MQ. Open-ended and script-based prompts remain difficult for most models; only Seedance 2.0 and Kling 3.0 consistently exceed 3.0 on MQ.

Complex Instructions. Compound multi-instruction is where Seedance 2.0 pulls furthest ahead: MQ 4.00 and VPF 3.75, outscoring Kling 3.0 by over 1.0 point on MQ (Table 12). Seedance 1.5 Pro scored 2.13/2.25 on MQ/VPF for this sub-category, so complex instruction handling improved by nearly 2 points in the 2.0 generation. Veo 3.1 reaches 3.38 on VPF for new entity tasks—close to Seedance 2.0’s 3.88—but its MQ (2.50) lags, meaning it follows the instruction but produces weaker motion. Degree adverbs is the tightest sub-category: Seedance 2.0 scores 3.20/3.40/3.40 with Seedance 1.5 Pro not far behind at 2.80/3.00/3.07.

Complex Camera. Seedance 2.0 leads on MQ for all three camera sub-categories and on VPF for combined shot instructions and advanced camera movement (Table 13). On difficult shots and special techniques, it scores 3.88 on IP—the highest single value in this table—while Kling 3.0 reaches 3.25. Kling 2.6 scores 3.38 on VPF for difficult shots—the best in that sub-category—handling special techniques better than general camera work. Advanced camera movement is the hardest sub-category: Seedance 2.0 and Kling 3.0 tie on MQ (2.71), and no model exceeds 3.14 on any metric. Camera flexibility is an area where all models have room to improve; advanced movement scores stay below 3.2 across the board.
paras.zh: 复杂镜头。Seedance 2.0 在所有三个镜头子类别上的 MQ 以及组合镜头指令和高级镜头移动的 VPF 上均领先（表 13）。在困难镜头和特殊技巧上，它的 IP 得分为 3.88——该表中的最高单一分值——而 Kling 3.0 达到 3.25。Kling 2.6 在困难镜头的 VPF 上得分为 3.38——该子类别中最佳——处理特殊技巧优于一般镜头工作。高级镜头移动是最难的子类别：Seedance 2.0 和 Kling 3.0 在 MQ 上持平（2.71），且没有任何模型在任何指标上超过 3.14。镜头灵活性是所有模型都有改进空间的领域；高级移动得分全面低于 3.2。

paras.en: Leveraging significant advancements in foundational capabilities and multimodal task performance, Seedance 2.0 delivers an entirely new creative experience for users. It can synthesize temporally precise and complex interactive scenes with high fidelity. As shown in the first and second rows of Figure 4, the generation process maintains exceptional motion quality by strictly adhering to real-world physical laws of motion, avoiding physical anomalies commonly observed in earlier AI-generated videos. For example, in the skating scenario, the model effectively renders a series of highly demanding maneuvers—such as synchronized take-offs, mid-air rotations, and precise landings. In response to the diversified demands of video content production, Seedance 2.0 demonstrates exceptional scenario adaptability in the third row of Figure 4. Whether applied to commercial advertising, television visual effects, video game animation, or explainer videos, the model consistently delivers high-quality generation results and robust multimodal task performance. By replacing complex visual effects pipelines and live-action workflows with AI-driven generation, Seedance 2.0 significantly reduces the production costs of professional audio and video content, shortens production cycles, and empowers both creators and enterprises to more effectively realize their creative visions.
paras.zh: 借助基础能力与多模态任务性能的重大进展，Seedance 2.0 将为用户带来全新的创作体验。它能够以高保真度合成时间精确且复杂的交互场景。如图 4 第一行和第二行所示，生成过程严格遵循真实世界的物理运动规律，保持了卓越的运动质量，避免了早期 AI 生成视频中常见的物理异常。例如，在滑冰场景中，模型有效渲染了一系列高难度动作——如同步起跳、空中旋转和精准落地。针对视频内容制作的多样化需求，Seedance 2.0 在图 4 第三行展现出卓越的场景适应性。无论是商业广告、电视视觉效果、游戏动画还是科普视频，模型都能持续提供高质量的生成结果和稳健的多模态任务性能。通过用 AI 驱动生成替代复杂的视觉特效流程和真人拍摄工作流，Seedance 2.0 大幅降低了专业音视频内容的生产成本，缩短了制作周期，并帮助创作者和企业更高效地实现其创作愿景。

paras.en: Competition-level pair figure skating scene. The opening low-angle shot follows the skate blades, capturing clear ice shavings and reflections. As the rotation sequence begins, the male skater's axis drifts slightly, causing a brief collapse in rotational rhythm. The female skater quickly adjusts her center of gravity, signals calmly with a look and says "Stay with me," actively guiding her partner back into sync. The movement then seamlessly transitions into a lift with clean, stable lines. The climax is a synchronized jump combination with straight aerial postures and decisive landings, perfectly matched to the music and visuals. The female skater wears a dark blue figure skating dress; the male skater wears competitive sportswear. The overall narrative moves from tense mistakes to a calm completion of the routine, showcasing the technical ability and psychological strength of top-level pair figure skating.
paras.zh: 竞技级双人花样滑冰现场。开场低机位跟随冰刀滑行，冰屑与反光细节清晰。进入旋转段，男选手轴线微偏出现失误，旋转节奏短暂塌陷。女选手迅速调整重心，眼神冷静并示意“Stay with me”，主动引导男选手重新对齐节奏。随后无缝衔接托举动作，线条干净稳定。高潮为同步跳跃组合，空中姿态笔直，落冰果断，音画完美对齐。女选手身着深蓝花滑裙，男选手为竞技运动装。整体呈现从紧张失误到冷静完成比赛的完整叙事，体现顶级双人花样滑冰中的技术能力与心理强度。

paras.en: A wuxia-style audio-visual blockbuster: in a bamboo forest, a white-clad swordsman faces off against a straw-cloaked blade master. The camera slowly pushes between the two, shifting focus between raindrops and the sword hilt, with the atmosphere tense to the extreme and only the sound of rain audible. Suddenly, a thunderclap flashes, and both charge at the same time. A side-tracking shot moves at extreme speed, capturing footsteps splashing through mud. At the moment their weapons clash, the frame cuts to extreme slow motion, clearly revealing the circular shockwave formed by the blade and sword blasting raindrops away, as well as the bamboo leaves severed by the sword qi. It then returns to normal speed, with the two landing back-to-back. The straw-cloaked blade master's bamboo hat splits apart, and the shot abruptly ends.
paras.zh: 武侠风格视听大片，竹林里白衣剑客与蓑衣刀客对峙。镜头在两人之间缓慢推移，焦点在雨滴和剑柄之间切换，气氛压抑到极点，只能听见雨声。突然一道惊雷闪过，两人同时冲锋，侧拍镜头极速平移，捕捉泥浆飞溅的脚步。双兵相接瞬间画面切换为极慢动作，清晰展示刀剑震飞雨水形成的圆环激波，以及被剑气切断的竹叶。随后恢复常速两人背对背落地，蓑衣刀客的斗笠裂开，画面戛然而止。

paras.en: The figure in the painting looks guilty — eyes darting left and right, then peeks out beyond the picture frame. Quickly reaches a hand out of the frame, picks up a cola, takes a sip, and breaks into a deeply satisfied expression. Just then, the sound of footsteps approaches. The figure hurriedly puts the cola back in its place. At that moment, a Western cowboy walks up, picks up the cola from the glass, and walks away with it. The closing shot pushes in to a top-lit close-up of the cola against a pure black background. At the bottom of the frame, stylized artistic subtitles appear alongside a voiceover: "宜口可乐，不可不尝！"
paras.zh: 画中人物看起来神色慌张——眼睛左右瞟动，然后探出画框之外。它迅速把手伸出画框，拿起一瓶可乐，喝了一口，露出非常满足的表情。就在这时，脚步声传来。人物赶紧把可乐放回原处。这时，一位西部牛仔走过来，从玻璃台面上拿起可乐，径直走了。结尾镜头推近，在纯黑背景上以顶光特写可乐。画面底部出现艺术风格字幕，同时伴随画外音：“宜口可乐，不可不尝！”
